story:
Ria hated homework. One day, her pencil suddenly spoke! “Use me wisely,” it said, “and I’ll help you learn anything.”

Surprised, Ria started writing carefully. The pencil made her drawings beautiful and her writing neat.

But one day, she got lazy again. The pencil stopped working.

“Why?” she cried.

“Because magic only works with effort,” the pencil replied.

Ria smiled and started trying again—and the magic returned.

Moral: Hard work makes everything better.
